next.reason: 1985: every separately compiled program in a sequence 'must be terminated by an end program header except for the last program'. §2023:10.7.3 SR1: 'An end marker shall be present in every source unit that contains, is contained in, or precedes another source unit' (contains/contained is 1985 X.2.3.2 SR1). Compile-time in both; the same sequences accepted and refused. GR-10.7.4-1 (the marker ends the unit) and FMT-10.6.1 state no part of this requirement.
